Case note: C.P.(IB) No. 2033/2023
Client: Swati Desai (cardiologist, Nashik)
Opposing party: M/s Goyal Holdings Ltd
Court: NCLT Mumbai
Filed on: 28 May 2023
Claim amount: ₹81,36,00,000
Issue: cross-border insolvency. The foreign administrator wants control of the assets in this country.
Advice given: Seek recognition of the foreign insolvency proceeding.
Outcome: The foreign proceeding was recognised.
Recommended next step: Coordinate with the foreign administrator.
